weaknesses.title: FILTERGLOB *bin* matches binary.dat (shell glob false friend)
weaknesses.detail: Agents wanting extension-only must use *.bin not *bin*. Shell glob matches anywhere in basename/full path field. No extension-only filter mode.

weaknesses.title: EXTALL empty fields for no-ext; FREQ yields :N bare key
weaknesses.detail: README and directory basenames produce empty EXTALL fields. FREQ of empties is ':2' — hard for LOOKUP and PRINT_JSON agents. No (none) sentinel.
weaknesses.repro: EXTALL then FREQ → :2 for no-ext count

weaknesses.title: STEMALL last-suffix only (pkg.tar.gz → pkg.tar)
weaknesses.detail: Double-extension archives keep intermediate suffix in stem. Same as STEM single-path class.

weaknesses.title: PATHGLOB scan still mixes directories into PATHS
weaknesses.detail: FILTERGLOB/VFILTERGLOB do not remove dirs unless pattern matches. nested/ survives deny *.tmp/*.log. No files-only PATHGLOB or FILTERISFILE.

weaknesses.title: No multi-pattern FILTERGLOB / allow-list OR
weaknesses.detail: Allow *.bin OR *.so needs two FILTERGLOB runs then UNION, or sequential deny. No FILTERGLOB bag '*.bin|*.so' or multi-pat form.
weaknesses.repro: want bins+sos → UNION of two FILTERGLOB

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Stable issue — path bags unreadable as arrays from plate JSON alone.

weaknesses.title: HASLINE exact: basename token misses full-path bag
weaknesses.detail: After PATHGLOB, has app.bin fails; need full path. Expected exactness but traps agents who only keep basenames in mind.

workarounds: Use *.ext patterns not *ext* for extension gates
Map empty EXTALL to (none) before FREQ if needed
ISDIR filter or allow-only patterns to drop directories
UNION two FILTERGLOB results for multi-type allow
Prefer BASENAMEALL then HASLINE on names for basename membership
issues_faced: FREQ of empty ext → :2 awkward key
